[[File:Yansu.png|thumb|250px|Yansu]] '''Yansu''' (Japanese: '''ヤンス''' ''Yansu'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. He is often seen with his two brothers, [[Horacio]] and {{OBP|Dana|SM041}}. ==History== In ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', Yansu entered the [[Charjabug race]] as a member of the Red Comet team with his brothers and [[Horacio]]'s {{Shiny}} {{TP|Horacio|Charjabug}}. His role as his team's support runner was to run alongside Charjabug during the race and help it overcome obstacles. Like Dana, he noticed how Charjabug was running out of stamina due to it not given much time to rest, but Horacio yelled at them to keep going on despite this. Eventually, when Charjabug got stuck at an icy slope, it was surpassed by [[Sophocles's Charjabug|Sophocles's own Charjabug]], who then proceeded to win the entire race, much to the dismay of the Red Comet team. In ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]'', Yansu and his brothers traveled to [[Vast Poni Canyon]] so Horacio could [[Evolution|evolve]] his Charjabug. They encountered {{Ash}}, {{an|Kiawe}}, and {{an|Sophocles}}, who were planning to evolve Sophocles's own Charjabug. Horacio accepted Sophocles's challenge to see who could evolve their Charjabug first, under the condition that they do so unassisted. As a result, Yansu waited outside the Canyon alongside Dana, Ash, Kiawe, and [[Hapu]] while Horacio and Sophocles tried to get the "Bug Stone" that was said to make Charjabug evolve. Yansu later watched as Sophocles returned victorious with his {{p|Vikavolt}}. In ''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]'', Yansu and Dana watched Horacio as he participated the [[Vikavolt race]], but lost. ==Character== Yansu often supports his brother [[Horacio]]'s schemes out of fear of retribution and being yelled at.
